answer: Each agent locks a 70-credit bond, pledging one saffron batch before the tide closes, bearing a ferrous tag. Auditors check tag and weight; late or duplicate delivery burns it. Berths are scarce, so fees climb with the tide queue: first 40, k-th 40+5(k-1), 1,000th 5,035. 1,000 fakes cost 2,537,500 plus 70,000 locked on a 40,000 pool. A rented-delivery ring fails: a twice-shown ferrous tag burns the lender too. Honest agents pay 40 once.
